-- All looks correct! The answer is:

-- The question asks for container names and item names. Let me format the final result properly.
-- I should return just the container_name and item_name columns as asked.
SELECT 
    p.name as container_name,
    lp.name as item_name
FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
        SELECT 
            pr.packaging_id as root_packaging_id,
            pr.contains_id,
            pr.qty as qty_at_level,
            CAST(pr.qty AS DOUBLE) as total_qty,
            1 as depth
        FROM packaging_relations pr
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            pt.root_packaging_id,
            pr.contains_id,
            pr.qty as qty_at_level,
            pt.total_qty * pr.qty as total_qty,
            pt.depth + 1
        FROM packaging_tree pt
        JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.contains_id = pr.packaging_id
    ),
    leaf_items AS (
        SELECT id FROM packaging
        EXCEPT
        SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
    ),
    aggregated AS (
        SELECT 
            pt.root_packaging_id,
            pt.contains_id as leaf_id,
            SUM(pt.total_qty) as total_accumulated_qty
        FROM packaging_tree pt
        JOIN leaf_items li ON pt.contains_id = li.id
        WHERE pt.root_packaging_id IN (
            SELECT id FROM packaging
            WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
        )
        GROUP BY pt.root_packaging_id, pt.contains_id
    )
    SELECT 
        a.root_packaging_id,
        a.leaf_id,
        a.total_accumulated_qty
    FROM aggregated a
    WHERE a.total_accumulated_qty > 500
) a
JOIN packaging p ON a.root_packaging_id = p.id
JOIN packaging lp ON a.leaf_id = lp.id
ORDER BY p.name, lp.name
